copper mountain.note: Good morning! Here's your snow report for Wednesday, November 11th. Bluebird skies prevail again today, as unseasonably warm temps continue for a few more days. Mid-40s can be expected with light WNW winds. Wintery weather should finally make an appearance this weekend kicking off a week of what will hopefully be off and on snow, and colder temps. Hope to see you out there! Lifts & terrain: American Eagle will be spinning at 9 AM with access to Rhapsody, Fair Play and Main Vein. Please note: NO green/beginner terrain is currently available. Woodward Copper : An early-season hike-to park is open at the top of American Eagle. Uphill access: Uphill travel is CLOSED at Copper Mountain. Uphill access is expected to open mid-December. Parking & transportation: All interior lots are paid parking lots. The Flyer Lot is restricted to parking pass holders only, while the Alpine Lot is free for day skier parking. The Copper Loop and Blue Route buses run starting at 5:30 AM. Food & beverage: Several restaurants are open for the season, including Sawmill Pizza and Taphouse, Aerie Food Hall, Downhill Dukes, plus Jack’s Bar & Slopeside Grill. Hours are available on our website.
